text:
elaine: Heads-up: customers reporting routes billed to project=null while sa is present. Looks like a recent sampling change removed project claims for high-QPS flows.

omar: Confirmed on staging. The sampler runs before enrichment for a subset of edge routes; enrichment never runs so console sees no project.

deploy-bot: deploy: auth-sampler v0.9.0 -> prod canary at 2024-10-02T11:02:00Z

riley: Quick mitigation idea: emit a tiny "attr_hint" flag from the sampler when it drops fields (e.g., attr_hint:"sa_cached" or "org_trimmed") so console can display "inferred" vs "claimed" without adding project IDs to telemetry.

ovince: We should add an "attr_confidence" field (HIGH/MED/LOW) and a banner UX explaining that inferred attributions can change billing numbers. Also add an internal-only debug field with last_enriched_ts.

ops: Cost note: flags are cheap but if product starts showing inferred project names we'll increase cardinality. Keep project IDs out of hot telemetry. Toggle default off; opt-in pilots only.

omar: Implementation plan: 1) sampler emits attr_hint + attr_confidence (default no change) 2) auth-enricher can optionally re-run for piloted orgs 3) console shows confidence badge and an "explain" link 4) pilot with infra and 3 customers.

elainE: Owners: Elaine (product comms), Omar (sampler), Riley (console UX), Ops (runbook). I'll write the customer banner copy and the rollout doc.

console-bot: feature request created: CONSOLE-1722 "attribution confidence + hint UX"

ops: Add circuit-breaker: if inferred_ratio > 25% for 1h, auto-disable hints and alert SRE/billing.

elainE: Thanks team — sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to finalize toggles. :thumbsup:
